data.exact_reserve_text: Favourable run-off experience and reserve releases in the year across all classes except the Political Risk and Director & Officers classes. Strengthening of Political Risk reserves as a consequence of specific adverse experience and a re-evaluation of reserves in the light of the deterioration in global economic conditions which occurred during 2020.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a mixed prior year development in 2020, resulting in an overall gross release of GBP 0.816 million. This was driven by favourable run-off experience and reserve releases across most classes, which offset strengthening of Political Risk reserves due to specific adverse experience, a re-evaluation of reserves, and deterioration in global economic conditions. The development impacts underwriting years 2015 through 2018.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year development calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 15) for underwriting years 2015-2018. Narrative on page 2 indicates a net strengthening for the 2018 YOA claims, but also overall favourable run-off experience and reserve releases across other classes. LOB movements are qualitative as specific amounts were not quantified.
